description: FDA National Drug Code (NDC) directory lookup via openFDA by product or package NDC (dashed, or 10/11-digit billing format) or by drug name. Useful for pharmacy, claims and inventory data. Returns product NDC, brand and generic names, labeler, dosage form, route, active ingredients and strengths, marketing category and dates, application number, DEA schedule and packages, with DailyMed link and retrievedAt. Errors: 400 invalid input, 404 no match. PAID: $0.002 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/fda/ndc.
name: fda_ndc_lookup
title: FDA NDC directory lookup
